description: Superuser/God only: list the shared UnClick Dropbox workspace. No personal Dropbox connection is used. area is strictly Context or System Information.

limit.description: Most entries to return, 1-200 (default 100). Folders come first, then files newest first.

relative_path.description: Optional folder below the area, never an absolute path. Omit for the area root.

name: unclick_workspace_list
